card.name: Endings of -itis disease names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a long medical word ending in -itis, such as tendinitis, hepatitis, pneumonitis, retinitis and endometritis. It is strongest in capitalized boxed-warning headings.

modes.label: Boxed warning headings
modes.description: The -itis ending of an all-caps condition name in a boxed warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS ADVERSE REACTIONS INCLUDING TENDINIT<<IS>>, TENDON RUPTURE,

modes.label: Hepatitis spelled in caps
modes.description: The middle piece IT inside HEPATITIS in warning headings.
modes.example: WARNING: PATIENTS CO-INFECTED WITH HEPAT<<IT>>IS B VIRUS (HBV)

modes.label: Lowercase in running text
modes.description: The -itis ending of a condition named in ordinary sentences.
modes.example: V retinit<<is>> and prevention of CMV disease in transplant

card.plain: It lights up near the end of inflammation words like tendinitis or hepatitis, especially in boxed warnings.
